title: Bombay High Court orders probe into alleged forgery of court orders
description: The Bombay High Court has ordered a police and cyber cell inquiry into allegations that forged or fabricated court orders were circulated in connection with a family dispute between members of the Jindal family [Rekha Parmanand Jindal v. Shylender Jindal & Ors.].Justice Arif S Doctor observed that the issue involved extremely serious and grave allegations, while ordering that an investigation be carried out before the court proceeds further.
